scientific_integrity: Proof is analytical for all positive part sizes and thresholds; computational enumeration is only a finite check. Prior-work comparisons are bounded, and no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only synchronous common-threshold binary dynamics on loopless complete bipartite graphs; literature residual risk for inaccessible early full text and unindexed studies.
title: A two-step attractor and complete orbit census for synchronous \(k\)-reversible dynamics on bicliques
